about.heroTitle: ChillyFlakes: Connecting You Directly to India’s Master Artisans & Village Makers
about.heroSubtitle: ChillyFlakes is just our brand name — behind it is a living collective of rural weavers, clay potters, spice growers, and skilled community practitioners across India, selling authentic goods directly to your home with zero exploitative middlemen.
about.missionHeading: Preserving Ancestral Crafts & Empowering Independent Creators
about.missionP1: In an era dominated by mass-manufactured plastics and synthetic fragrances, ChillyFlakes was created to honor the timeless heritage of Indian handcrafted artistry. We travel directly into village clusters across Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Rajasthan, West Bengal, and Kashmir to meet the individuals who shape clay, spin handloom khadi, distill cold-pressed oils, and harvest organic spices.
about.missionP2: When you buy from ChillyFlakes, you are not buying from an anonymous factory. You are directly supporting the artisan's household, keeping indigenous techniques alive, and receiving authentic goods certified for natural purity.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Learn more about our authentic handmade sourcing, community services, and artisan direct-selling.
faq.q1: How does ChillyFlakes verify that products are truly handmade and natural?
faq.a1: Every artisan partner on ChillyFlakes undergoes rigorous onboarding verification. We review artisan cards, geographical origin documents, batch purity tests, and photograph authentic production setups. No chemical fillers, toxic foaming agents, or artificial preservatives are permitted.
faq.q2: I am a rural artisan or self-help group. How do I start selling?
faq.a2: We welcome master craftspeople, handloom weavers, and organic cultivators from all Indian states. Click "Become a Seller" in our header or select "Artisan / Craftsman Direct Selling" on this form. Our regional coordinator will guide you through digital onboarding and zero-upfront-cost store setup.
faq.q3: How do community service appointments work (e.g. Massage, Tutoring)?
faq.a3: You can browse verified local practitioners under our Services tab, select a convenient date and time, and submit your request. The service provider will confirm the appointment directly with you via phone/WhatsApp.
faq.q4: What are your delivery timelines for domestic and interstate orders?
faq.a4: Handmade items are lovingly prepared and packed by the artisan within 24–48 hours. Standard courier delivery takes 3–5 business days across major Indian cities, and 4–7 days for remote destinations.
faq.q5: Do you offer bulk corporate gifts, custom wedding favors, or export orders?
faq.a5: Yes! We frequently organize bespoke artisan gift boxes (spice hampers, handmade soaps, brass lamps, and handloom shawls) for festive occasions, weddings, and eco-conscious businesses. Choose "Bulk / Wholesale & Corporate Gifting" in the form below.
